verdict.rationale: uv supports some batch-style operations — bulk-adding all dependencies from a requirements.txt via `uv add -r`, workspace support for managing many sub-projects at once, and clearing the entire cache in one command — but there's no evidence of AI-native bulk/automation features (e.g., scripted batch processing across many scripts/tools, parallel multi-target operations) beyond these package-manager conveniences. missing for 10: dedicated bulk/batch command for running operations across many scripts or tools simultaneously, evidence of AI-agent-oriented batch automation, independent confirmation of bulk workflows at scale.
